reviews.text: I'm the same Eduardo from the previous review. I just want to register my disregard for Ms. Rita, who at no point admitted her mistake (which would have been fair given the terrible service she provided), and unfortunately, for the owner, Mr. Igor, whom I considered a very nice person, given the attention he gave me until yesterday. I know I was never just any customer; I always made a point of buying everything Duda needed from them because I was always well taken care of. So far, no one has even bothered to apologize. Now I'm ashamed to walk down the street with this mess made on my little one's backside. I was a customer for five years, I was out of São Paulo for the last two, and upon returning I'm faced with this awful service. Oh, and the store is falling apart; it looks like they're moving, everything is a mess, there are no products, things are thrown around for customers to see. When I saw it this morning, I almost gave up on leaving my children there. What a mess, what a shame.

If I could, I'd give zero stars. I've always brought my dog ​​here and always received excellent service from Gabi. Today I discovered they don't groom on Saturdays, but Rita, not wanting to lose a customer, scheduled a grooming session for my other puppy, a 4-month-old Maltese. She simply ruined all the dog's fur and, to make matters worse, did this awful thing to the poor thing's bottom. I spent all this time waiting to be able to walk my dog, and now I'm ashamed. And the worst part was her trying to convince me that this is the standard. I'll never take my dog ​​to this location again; in fact, I'll only take him to the other one because my female dog loves Gabi. Don't fall for this "RITA" woman's tricks!
Excellent service, qualified professionals, super careful and loving with pets. I highly recommend them.
Thank you very much.
They are very careful, groom very well, are very meticulous in their work, and are very punctual. I highly recommend them!

Today I had a terrible experience, but as always, we received "apologies."
I made an appointment via WhatsApp that started at 5 PM and ended at 10 PM, but I received "apologies" because blah blah blah...
Then it was scheduled for January 2nd at 10:30 AM for the bath and grooming, but... when I arrived it was CLOSED. Luckily, I received "apologies," after all, that solves everything.
The wasted time, the stress the cat goes through leaving home and going to another environment...
I tried to resolve it with the owner in the following way: he offered a driver to pick up my kitten and take him to the other unit (very far away) to have the bath and grooming done. I didn't accept because it's not reliable, and we went home with a bag of "apologies."
The kindness of the people who work with the animals has never been questioned, nothing to say about that, but the administration or organization, that's another story.
I loved it! ❤️
Excellent service and a pleasant atmosphere, all in one place.
Thank you very much

I simply loved the service at the pet shop! ❤️
My dogs were treated with such care and affection that you can really feel it. You can even tell they enjoy what they do; everything was done with so much attention that it made me feel super relaxed.

In addition, they were left very clean, smelling wonderful, and best of all: everything was done quickly, without any fuss or stress for my little ones. It's so good to find a place where pets are treated like part of the family.

Without a doubt, I've become a loyal customer. I recommend them without hesitation! 🐾💛
Thank you very much
Excellent service, I highly recommend it, my pet came back smelling wonderful ❤️
Today I took my two kittens for a bath and received excellent service. The pets were treated with outstanding care throughout the entire process. I definitely recommend them!
Perfect!! My dears, and the bath was great!

I loved it! I highly recommend it. My cat, Miles, hadn't had a bath in a long time because she lives in an apartment. They sent me videos saying she was a little skittish and that maybe a dry bath would be better. Then they sent me a message saying they had called a professional who knew how to handle her and that it would therefore take a little longer. I was very happy with the attention and communication during the process. She arrived home smelling great and with lots of shine!!!! I highly recommend it!

Complete disregard. I forgot my cell phone in that store, I called the owner and she didn't care at all, she didn't inform the employees. I arrived and my cell phone was still there... if I hadn't arrived, they would have already taken it, the employees didn't even know. I'll never go back... the place is horrible.
Excellent experience! Zaya is 13 years old and the care was incredible... Not to mention the smell and shine of her fur.

Excellent service, professionalism rated 10/10.
Careful and kind to the pets, I highly recommend them.
Amazing! It was my dog's first bath at a pet shop and I loved the service and care the staff showed me and her. I'll always take her there, you've gained a customer!

Wonderful service! It was my first time taking my dog ​​for a bath and grooming, and Igor and the team were sensational, very patient and caring with my little dog! Excellent service! They've gained a customer!

Excellent service, impeccable work, and everything done with lots of love, care, and respect! Patinhas and Cacau thank you and are already looking forward to the next beauty session 💙❤️
Congratulations to Gabi and Igor! …
Excellent service and customer care.

I would like to thank you for the excellent service at the pet shop! My puppy looks beautiful and your work was impeccable. I was very satisfied with the care and dedication of the entire team. Congratulations on the great work!

First time I took my 5-year-old baby Noah, today, October 18th, 2024, and I have to say, I highly recommend Igor. His service is spectacular, and Gabi is an expert in what she does, super loving and attentive to pets. The best service in the Bela Vista neighborhood. They've gained another client, and I will definitely recommend them. Wonderful professionals, I just have to thank Igor and Gabi! 🫶🏼
I received excellent service; they were patient with me and did a great job.
The service and care for the animals were wonderful, I was delighted with the attention, the service, and the attention! Seriously, highly recommended!
